paragraphs: Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi Yishmael.

He is mentioned in [Shemot Rabbah 51:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Shemot_Rabbah.51.4), where he said: “It is a testimony to all who come into the world that there is forgiveness for Israel.” The saying is also cited in [Tanchuma, Pekudei 2 (Buber’s recension)](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Tanchuma_Buber,_Pekudei.2.1), where it reads: “Rabbi Yishmael said.” Buber conjectures there that someone noted beside it the variant reading “Rabbi Shimon”; a second person then combined the two readings, producing “Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi Yishmael.”[^1]

notes.text: Buber’s recension of Tanchuma has “forgiveness only for Israel”; Shemot Rabbah has “forgiveness for Israel.”
